0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, 1st in the Northwest, 4th in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (5-0, 1st in the Southwest and 1st in the West), who are riding a five-game winning streak. The Thunder are without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while the Rockets are missing Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, though their most recent meeting was a 112-106 loss in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026.
